title: THE CARD IN THE DRAWER · The walk map
venue: the motel · a card left in room twelve's nightstand each month by a guest never seen · Box 12
logline: The eighth and last card, September, the month the Legacy turns its first year: a figure in a wreath with four creatures at the corners. He redraws it as the walk map from the corkboard — the dotted line's loop as the wreath — with a gull, a crab, a dog and a stick figure at the corners. He's done this before too. The drawer is empty the next month and every month after. The guest never came back, or never came.

panels.composition: A single tall card filling the page, its border drawn as the wooden edge of a motel nightstand drawer; inside the border: the hand-drawn walk map with its dotted route closed into a wreath, and at its four corners a gull, a crab, a dog and a stick figure, small. No numeral, no title; the card's name is the thing.
props: the walk map as a wreath
